description: Retrieval evaluation set (agentic workflows and RAG plan, AG2). Each case is a question and the stored documents a good search must surface: {"kind": "report", "ref": "<report id>"}, {"kind": "filing", "ref": "<evidence sha256>"}, {"kind": "thesis", "ref": "<ticker>"}, {"kind": "note", "ref": "<note id>"}, {"kind": "news", "ref": "<news item id>"}. Write the cases against the real corpus after the first document_index run, including paraphrased queries that share no words with the passage, then run `python -m steward.retrieval.eval --k 5` and keep the embeddings only if hybrid recall beats keyword recall. See steward/retrieval/eval.py.
